partial_pooling: common standardized factors + penalized asset intercept and asset x 4 standardized shock deviations; penalty ratio10/100; alpha300/3000
tuning: Each factor origin: previous year temporal inner validation with20day label embargo; no outer cal/test tuning. Trees fixed150depth3lr.04. Variant selection only2020/21 development.
training: Daily overlapping5day targets. Outer previous year strictly reserved calibration;20calendar-day label embargo. Identical locked stock/date evaluation keys.
residual_training: Annual forward-only OOF linear errors, outcomes finish before outer training cutoff. No in-sample linear residual targets.
support: 12dim state+shock IQR scaled neighbor distance, historical anchors6days, threshold95% of historical neighbor distances excluding20day-near points; taper residual weight1->0 from ratio1->2. This is heuristic support, not probability.
intervals: HAR-style daily squared-return proxy with1/5/22 horizons (not intraday HAR-RV)
evaluation: historical observed future shocks as conditions; not causal or ex-ante shock prediction; reused research evaluation not blind
acceptance: relative centerMAE vszero and CatBoost; pinball/intervalscore vsunconditional; crash breaches and stockheterogeneity guards. No5pp cap.
limitations: Missing available_at, no historical revision vintages, current20 survivorship. Rows across stocks not independent. No airline/refinery in current20.
